description: This file implements undo/redo functionality for the map editor in the Wesnoth game, including managing undo/redo stacks, actions, and related data structures.

classes.name: map_undo_action
classes.description: Represents an undoable action in the map editor, including terrain changes, selections, map data, and starting locations.

methods.name: map_undo_action::map_undo_action
methods.description: Constructor initializing the undo action flags to false.

methods.name: map_undo_action::undo_terrains
methods.description: Returns the map of old terrains for undo.

methods.name: map_undo_action::redo_terrains
methods.description: Returns the map of new terrains for redo.

methods.name: map_undo_action::undo_selection
methods.description: Returns the set of old selection locations for undo.

methods.name: map_undo_action::redo_selection
methods.description: Returns the set of new selection locations for redo.

methods.name: map_undo_action::old_map_data
methods.description: Returns the old map data string.

methods.name: map_undo_action::new_map_data
methods.description: Returns the new map data string.

methods.name: map_undo_action::undo_starting_locations
methods.description: Returns the map of old starting locations for undo.

methods.name: map_undo_action::redo_starting_locations
methods.description: Returns the map of new starting locations for redo.

methods.name: map_undo_action::add_terrain
methods.description: Adds a terrain change to the undo action.

methods.name: map_undo_action::terrain_set
methods.description: Checks if terrain changes are set.

methods.name: map_undo_action::set_selection
methods.description: Sets the selection change for undo.

methods.name: map_undo_action::selection_set
methods.description: Checks if selection change is set.

methods.name: map_undo_action::set_map_data
methods.description: Sets the map data change for undo.

methods.name: map_undo_action::map_data_set
methods.description: Checks if map data change is set.

methods.name: map_undo_action::add_starting_location
methods.description: Adds a starting location change to the undo action.

methods.name: map_undo_action::starting_location_set
methods.description: Checks if starting location change is set.

methods.name: add_undo_action
methods.description: Pushes an undo action onto the undo stack and clears redo stack.

methods.name: exist_undo_actions
methods.description: Returns true if there are undo actions available.

methods.name: exist_redo_actions
methods.description: Returns true if there are redo actions available.

methods.name: pop_undo_action
methods.description: Pops the last undo action, moves it to redo stack, and returns it.

methods.name: pop_redo_action
methods.description: Pops the last redo action, moves it to undo stack, and returns it.

methods.name: clear_undo_actions
methods.description: Clears both undo and redo stacks.
